title: Euclidean Hausdorff measure under the similarity x ↦ c + R x
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ (n = 0 allowed), let c ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ} = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+ℓ)) and R > 0, and put ψ(x) := c + R x. Let H^n := μHE[n] be Mathlib's Euclidean Hausdorff measure on ℝ^{n+ℓ}. Then the push-forward of H^n under ψ equals R^{-n} H^n: Measure.map ψ H^n = (ENNReal.ofReal (R^n))⁻¹ • H^n.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (c : Amb n ℓ) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).map (fun x => c + R • x) = (ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ n))⁻¹ • (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ))
